name: Hajimemashite Boku no Kanojo
original_name: はじめましてボクのカノジョ
source:
"Do you remember me?"

After coming home from work, I spotted a young woman sitting at my door.
I don't recall ever having known her.

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/25714]Freem![/url]]
translation:
“你还记得我吗？”

下班回家后，我发现一位年轻女子坐在我家门口。
我不记得曾经认识她。

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/25714]Freem![/url]]
